user.title: Solar Powerflow · equipment
user.description: Tick the installed equipment, then what should appear on the card. The next step shows one settings tab per ticked equipment.

data.name: Installation name
data.show_battery: Show the battery on the card
data.show_router: Show the router on the card
data.show_cumulus: Show the water heater on the card

data_description.name: Card title and device name in Home Assistant.
data_description.show_battery: Ignored when no battery is installed.
data_description.show_router: Ignored when no router is installed.
data_description.show_cumulus: Ignored when no water heater is installed.

entities.title: Solar Powerflow · sensors
entities.description: One tab per equipment: click its title to expand or collapse it. Powers in kW are converted to W automatically.

pv.name: ☀️ Photovoltaics
pv.description: Production, house consumption and installation power.

data.load_includes_cumulus: House consumption includes the water heater

data_description.pv_power: Instant solar power sensor (W or kW).
data_description.load_power: Instant consumption sensor for the whole house.
data_description.pv_peak: Peak power (W). Scales the gauges and the flow speed.
data_description.load_includes_cumulus: Ticked: the water heater is part of the total consumption (main meter). The water heater detail is deducted from it.
data_description.grid_import_threshold: Below this, the computed import is ignored: no animated flow, no badge, self-sufficiency not reduced.

battery.name: 🔋 Battery
battery.description: State of charge, charge and discharge power, capacity.

data_description.capacity: Usable capacity (kWh). 0 hides the stored energy.

router.name: 🔀 Solar router
router.description: Router measurements, all optional: shown in the card details. The surplus sent to the router is always computed from production and consumption.

data_description.cumulus_flow: Power sent to the water heater by the router (W). Used for the water heater when its tab has no power sensor.

data_description.heating_power: Power drawn by the heating element (W). Optional if the router already measures the flow to the water heater.
data_description.max_setpoint: Target maximum temperature (°C). The gauge fills up to this value.

error.same_entity: Production and consumption must be two different sensors.
error.battery_power: Provide at least the battery charge power or discharge power.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Solar Powerflow is already configured. Use “Configure” to change the settings.
